description: Kindle Voyage (7th generation), stock firmware 5.13.6. Measured identity is filled (bootmode=main, eips, uname, cmdline, partitions, stock_functions, MACH_TYPE 4091 build pin). experimental_first_test allows packaging an experimental entry only; device_confirmed stays false until a real Voyage Android boot. Not a daily-use / release claim.
machine_why: TARGET_MACHINE / transition r1. Offline: GPL mach-types mx6sl_wario=4091; imx60_wario_defconfig enables only CONFIG_MACH_MX6SL_WARIO; matching stock Image machine_desc.nr is 4091 next to name Freescale i.MX 6SoloLite based Wario Board (same Hardware string the device reported). ATAGs do not carry this number. measured.machine_id stays null.

partition_table.ro_note: sysfs ro=0 is the block read-only flag. The root filesystem is mounted read-only. Those are not the same fact, and neither one authorizes writing mmcblk0p1 or the boot partitions.
partition_table.starts_note: start was read for mmcblk0p1..p4 only. The whole disk and the boot nodes have no start in the extra probe by design.

measured.stock_functions_source: Offline format parse of the official update_kindle_voyage_5.13.6.bin (download SHA-256 80856a11…7a155b; that hash is integrity of the downloaded file, not an RSA signature check). KindleTool extract unpacked SP01→FB03 Recovery V2 without --unsigned and without modifying signatures. uImage sha256 add9b0a29a769c241144bf245de2b94848d24aabb5765662714d0afde5a9ca32 (IH_NAME Linux-3.0.35-lab126, load 0x80008000, uncompressed). zImage payload sha256 934302ee62ff8eea3aa41f1c2c5fef465e28590567573b7eaab084158c35e74e. Inflated Image sha256 bb15c17193f8a3b8dba3d27433fd7e6322ac013defcbff5c950ceee703f76530 contains the exact device banner Linux version 3.0.35-lab126 (builder@eink-builds) (gcc version 4.9.1 (GCC) ) #2 PREEMPT Thu Apr 8 09:39:57 UTC 2021. Bodies are SHA-256 of each symbol through the next kallsyms address, file offset = addr - 0xc0008000. Not the rebuilt Android kernel. Extracted code was not executed.
measured.bootmode_note: Recorded by tools/voyage-probe-bootmode.sh on 2026-11-12. Report sha256 eb98afc157f42877c40ea9032dd06ce23475dcb635c83a5a325c49645eb0292e (337 bytes). Satisfies the dd_atags main check only. Does not open installable / identity_ready / device_confirmed and is not a Voyage Android boot result.

source.firmware_note: Official update.bin, magic SP01, cert 2, inner FB03 Recovery V2, target OTA 3731990038. KindleTool extract (format parse; download SHA-256 is not RSA verification) yields imx60_wario/uImage matching the device uname banner. Signatures were not stripped or altered. Extracted blobs were not executed.
source.mach_types_note: arch/arm/tools/mach-types in the GPL member names mx6sl_wario as 4091. Copied into profile.machine as a build pin with stock_machine_desc_nr evidence. Not copied into measured.machine_id.
source.stock_machine_desc_note: In the inflated stock Image (sha256 bb15c171…76530), machine_desc.nr is the little-endian u32 4091 immediately before the pointer to stock_machine_desc_name. imx60_wario_defconfig sets CONFIG_MACH_MX6SL_WARIO=y and leaves the other MACH_MX6* boards unset. That is the TARGET_MACHINE pin. It is not a /proc reading.
source.bootmode_source_note: arch/arm/mach-mx6/boardid.c publishes /proc/bootmode from idme system_bootmode. dd_atags refuses anything other than main when building the handoff ATAG list. An empty read is a real first-boot risk for that path, not a profile-fill exercise. No ordinary rootfs file replaces a runtime reading; do not invent main.
source.machine_id_source_note: The numeric MACH_TYPE is r1 at kernel entry, stored as __machine_arch_type. ATAGs do not carry it. Handoff consumers: native_init refuses __machine_arch_type!=TARGET_MACHINE; transition.S loads PT_MACHINE into r1 for the new kernel; pw_plan_validate only checks machine_id==expected_machine_id on the plan itself. Offline Image+GPL proof of 4091 is sufficient for the build pin. Expanding to /proc/atags, boot partitions or memory is not required for this number and is not done.
source.phys_offset_note: arch/arm/plat-mxc/include/mach/memory.h defines MX6SL_PHYS_OFFSET as 0x80000000 and, under CONFIG_ARCH_MX6, selects MX6_PHYS_OFFSET 0x10000000. board-mx6sl_wario.c (pristine sha256 1091ae64f576d26e51d30949d30a04f53c2e51783b69d167229cce2759d5c563) uses MX6SL_PHYS_OFFSET for boot_params. The handoff does not adopt either address.
source.patches_note: On 2026-11-12 every patch under patches/*.patch and patches/android-core/*.patch applied with tools/apply-patch-series.py onto a fresh tree of this member. That is a source result, not a boot.

device_probe_bootmode.note: New runtime reading only. Does not explain the earlier empty extra-probe reading. Does not authorize installable, first boot, or space cleanup.
